name: Perov-5
description: 18,928 cubic ABX3 perovskites with relaxed structures, formation enthalpy (heat_all, eV/atom) and direct band gap (dir_gap, eV). The CDVAE split of the Castelli et al. (2012) perovskite set; the dataset behind the published MEIDNet model and the live Studio.
citation: Castelli et al., Energy Environ. Sci. 5, 5814 (2012); Xie et al., ICLR 2022 (CDVAE)
role: multimodal benchmark: inverse design, property prediction and representation

changes: **perov5-v1.1** (2026-10-05). Representation: the two latents are compared in the space where the model aligns them (before or after its projection heads), declared per method; the cosine in both spaces is recorded. Inverse design: novelty is measured against all 18,928 materials of the data set instead of the training split. Records may give the mean and the standard deviation over several training runs. Rows trained on all materials are marked, because their test scores are not held-out.
**perov5-v1** (2026-10-03). First version: three tasks, CDVAE split, novelty against the training split, latents compared after the projection heads.

tasks.name: Inverse design
tasks.summary: Propose cubic ABX3 perovskites for three band-gap targets in three chemical families (54 candidates); score them for stability with an MLIP, uniqueness, novelty and, where a DFT value exists, the target band gap.
tasks.headline: sun_rate
tasks.notes: SUN measures stability, uniqueness and novelty, not whether a candidate has the target band gap: methods that never return a composition of the data set, such as the two baselines, set a high reference for it. Of the compositions that pass the family's rules, 40 of the 106 oxides are in the data set and no chalcogenide or halide is, so novelty separates methods among oxides only. The DFT check is the only measure of the target and is possible for oxides whose A and B sites match a Perov-5 entry (40 of the 106 rule-passing oxides; 26 of them have a non-zero direct gap).

settings.mlip: MACE-MP-0 (medium), float32; BFGS with cell relaxation (FrechetCellFilter), fmax 0.05 eV/Å, at most 500 steps

metrics.label: SUN
metrics.definition: stable, unique and novel candidates divided by the budget of 54; a candidate that was not delivered counts as a failure

metrics.label: Stable
metrics.definition: fraction of delivered candidates whose MACE-MP-0 formation energy after relaxation is at most 0.10 eV/atom, against elemental reference phases (the criterion of `meidnet screen` and of the paper)

metrics.label: Unique
metrics.definition: fraction of delivered candidates whose composition does not repeat an earlier one

metrics.label: Novel
metrics.definition: fraction of delivered candidates whose composition is not in the data set (training, validation and test splits)

metrics.label: ΔH<sub>f</sub>
metrics.definition: median MACE-MP-0 formation energy of the delivered candidates

metrics.label: DFT hit
metrics.definition: among candidates whose A, B and X sites match a Perov-5 entry (so their DFT band gap is known), the fraction within 0.5 eV of the target

metrics.label: DFT known
metrics.definition: candidates with a known DFT band gap (the denominator of DFT hit)

metrics.label: Delivered
metrics.definition: candidates delivered out of the budget of 54

metrics.label: Valid
metrics.definition: fraction of the budget that passes every rule of the family

metrics.label: SUN count
metrics.definition: stable, unique and novel candidates

metrics.label: Budget
metrics.definition: candidates requested

metrics.label: Generated
metrics.definition: candidates generated (reported in the paper)

tasks.name: Property prediction
tasks.summary: Predict formation enthalpy and direct band gap from the crystal structure of the 3,785 test materials.
tasks.headline: mae_heat_all

metrics.label: MAE ΔH
metrics.definition: mean absolute error of the formation enthalpy (heat_all)

metrics.label: RMSE ΔH
metrics.definition: root-mean-square error of the formation enthalpy

metrics.label: R² ΔH
metrics.definition: coefficient of determination of the formation enthalpy (0 = no better than the mean)

metrics.label: MAE gap
metrics.definition: mean absolute error of the direct band gap over all test materials; 96% of them have a gap of 0 eV

metrics.label: MAE gap > 0
metrics.definition: mean absolute error of the direct band gap on the test materials with a non-zero gap, the range that inverse design targets

metrics.label: RMSE gap
metrics.definition: root-mean-square error of the direct band gap

metrics.label: R² gap
metrics.definition: coefficient of determination of the direct band gap; not informative here, because the gap is zero for most materials

metrics.label: MAE ΔH ≠ 0
metrics.definition: mean absolute error of the formation enthalpy on materials where it is not zero

metrics.label: n
metrics.definition: test materials evaluated

tasks.name: Representation
tasks.summary: How well the shared space holds both modalities on the test split: cross-modal retrieval, agreement of the two latents, and a k-nearest-neighbour probe of the structure latent.
tasks.headline: retrieval_top1

metrics.label: R@1
metrics.definition: fraction of test materials for which, among the distinct property profiles of the test split, their own profile's latent is the nearest to their structure latent (materials with identical property values share one profile)

metrics.label: R@5
metrics.definition: the same within the five nearest profiles

metrics.label: cos
metrics.definition: mean cosine similarity between the structure latent and the property latent of the same material, in the space where the model aligns them (before or after its projection heads; stated on the method's page)

metrics.label: k-NN MAE ΔH
metrics.definition: formation-enthalpy error of a 5-nearest-neighbour probe: each test material takes the mean property of its five nearest training materials in the representation

metrics.label: k-NN MAE gap
metrics.definition: direct-band-gap error of the same probe

metrics.label: L2
metrics.definition: mean L2 distance between the two latents of the same material (unit latents)

metrics.label: cos, encoder outputs
metrics.definition: the matched cosine between the normalised encoder outputs, before the projection heads

metrics.label: cos, projection heads
metrics.definition: the matched cosine between the outputs of the projection heads

metrics.label: profiles
metrics.definition: distinct property profiles among the test materials: the candidates of retrieval (chance level of R@1 is one over this number)

metrics.label: n
metrics.definition: test materials evaluated
